evidence.text: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 咼 represents the sound.  The simplified character 过 was adapted from the cursive form of the traditional character 過.
Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 咼 represents the sound.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *kloːl, *kloːls): semantic 辵 (“walk”) + phonetic 咼 (OC *kʰʷroːl).
From Proto-Sino-Tibetan *m/s-ka-j (“to go, to stride”) (STEDT). Related to 跨 (OC *kʰʷraː, *kʰʷraːʔ, *kʰʷraːs, *kʰʷaːs, “to pass over”) and 騎 (OC *ɡral, *ɡrals, “to ride”).

editorial_rules: Write about the character's graphic history; distinguish it from the history of a spoken word.
